title: Restriction of module sheaves to constant scalar sections
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a category with objects in universe $u$ and arrows in universe $v$, let $J$ be a Grothendieck topology on $\mathcal C$, and let $\Lambda$ be a commutative ring in universe $\max(u,v)$. Let $\underline\Lambda$ be the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], with sheafification unit $\iota:\Lambda^{\mathrm{pre}}\to\underline\Lambda$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification]. Define the constant-ring module restriction functor from sheaves of $\underline\Lambda$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] to sheaves valued in fixed-$\Lambda$ modules as follows. For $M$, retain its section groups and restriction maps, and give $M(U)$ the action $a\cdot m=\iota_U(a)m$. Its underlying module presheaf is denoted $\operatorname{Res}^{\mathrm{pre}}_\iota M$; the sheaf condition is that of the unchanged abelian presheaf. On a module-sheaf morphism retain the same section homomorphisms, now linear over $\Lambda$ by restriction along $\iota_U$. This defines $\operatorname{Res}_\iota:\operatorname{Mod}_J(\underline\Lambda)\to\operatorname{Sh}_J(\mathcal C,\operatorname{Mod}_\Lambda)$. No fibre products, terminal object, nonempty-site or nonzero-ring assumption is made.
